follow_ups.summary: Accessibility: Drawing toolbar close button: accessible name changes with layout and mixes disclosure and action semantics
follow_ups.detail: The close button carries aria-expanded="true" as a disclosure toggle, but its accessible name changes by layout: "Draw" in the vertical toolbar (visible label next to an X icon; tooltip "Close drawing tools") and "Close drawing tools" in the horizontal toolbar, announced as "Close drawing tools, expanded". Pick one pattern: a disclosure named "Draw" with aria-expanded in every layout, or a "Close drawing tools" action with no aria-expanded, and make the visible label, icon and tooltip agree with it.
follow_ups.next_step: Logged for Practice surface team. What to do, and where to track it, is decided later; nothing is filed until then. Raised while Design Infra ruled on verdict K3.
